description: Tiny, zero-dependency, accessible React image carousel that stacks photos like tilted polaroids, with a headless useCarousel hook.
rules: Import the named export: import { PolaroidCarousel } from "react-polaroid-carousel". There is no default export.
No CSS import is needed; the component is already a client component and can be rendered from Next.js Server Components.
Every item needs a meaningful alt. Use renderImage for Next.js <Image>.
Theme with CSS variables (--rpc-card-width, --rpc-frame, --rpc-caption-font) or unstyled + classNames; do not wrap it in a fixed-height box.
